scope: bounded supervised landmark experiment; no PPO; no control

main.code_version_pin: ultralytics==8.2.0 (proposed isolated-env pin; verify install/version before run)
main.license: AGPL-3.0; legal review required before distribution; custom weights are derivatives
main.why: one network emits bbox + one keypoint; directly fits visibility + green anchor + auxiliary bbox; RKNN model zoo has yolov8_pose RK3576 example

backup.license: Apache-2.0 code; COCO pretrained/dataset terms require separate review
backup.why: permissive license and tiny model; only bbox, anchor remains classical and therefore weaker

selection.rejected: segmentation (no mask consumer in V2.2; not selected)

input_output.input: RGB image, original 320x240; training letterbox to 640x640; intrinsics retained for bearing conversion
input_output.output: bbox + keypoint + class score; bbox auxiliary; image bearing = atan2(anchor_x-cx0, fx)

data.existing: all current data are exposed; use only train/validation; no current sealed test

next_new_capture.groups: minimum 3 new trajectory families not present in current data
next_new_capture.frames: 200-400 sampled across groups, not continuous random frames
next_new_capture.labels: bbox + one green-light keypoint for all positives; negatives empty; visibility/truncation/ambiguity flags
next_new_capture.sealed: freeze labels before final test; final test not seen during training/validation
next_new_capture.gui: foreground visible GUI DirectX/D3D12 if capture is needed; no headless

training_budget.checkpoint_selection: run validation consumer after each saved epoch/end; select highest validation joint score, tie-break lower FP; never inspect final test
training_budget.hardware: host RTX 5080 16GB is available read-only; isolated training environment not created in this package
training_budget.resource_estimate: 300-frame / 100-epoch nano run is expected to be hours-scale on the available GPU; verify before committing compute; not a committed benchmark

proposed_consumer_thresholds.notes: the 0.5% false-match target follows the V2.2 initial suggestion but cannot be certified with the current small sample; treat as PROPOSED and report INCOMPLETE if sample insufficient

metrics.bbox: IoU>=0.3 on labelled subset; report coverage
metrics.anchor: keypoint visible coverage; pixel error and image-bearing median/P90/max
metrics.joint: all-positive joint pass rate; successful-output coverage; UNKNOWN/REJECTED; per group/visibility/negative type
metrics.denominators: all positives retained; unlabeled localization samples reported separately; no deletion of failures
metrics.old_baseline: presence/bbox historical only; no physical anchor comparison

stop_conditions: validation joint <0.60 or no improvement over current rule baseline
train/validation gap >20 percentage points or persistent overfit
ONNX export or RKNN conversion fails / quantized validation drops >5 percentage points
final sealed test below proposed thresholds after one run; no post-test tuning
annotation/QA shows identity or keypoint labels unreliable
compute/data cannot support at least 3 independent groups

reproduce_plan.isolated_env: create .venv/landmark-train outside the Isaac venv; install pinned ultralytics==8.2.0 + torch/torchvision matching CUDA; do not modify E:\isaac\env_isaaclab
commands_planned: yolo pose train model=yolov8n-pose.pt data=configs/perception/landmark_yolo_pose_v1.yaml epochs=100 imgsz=640 batch=16 seed=0 patience=20 project=outputs/landmark/train
yolo export model=best.pt format=onnx imgsz=640 opset=18 simplify=True
RKNN model zoo examples/yolov8_pose/python/convert.py best.onnx rk3576 i8 (separate Linux RKNN environment; planned, not run)
